content_en.prompt: Spotted cuckoo birds move into empty nests: starting at the bottom of a tree, going up until finding a nest; if empty, moves in; if occupied, compares spots with the occupying bird — if that bird has more spots, continue left; if same or fewer, continue right. There is a tree with 5 empty nests. Below are 5 birds, shown left to right; they enter the tree one at a time in that left-to-right order, starting from the bottom, with the 4-spot bird going first.
content_en.question: Which bird will move into the highest nest?
content_en.explanation: The 4-spot bird takes the lowest nest. The 2-spot bird (fewer than 4) goes left to the next empty nest. The 3-spot bird goes left of the 4-spot nest (since 4>3), reaches the 2-spot bird's nest, and since 2<3 continues right into the next empty nest — the highest one. So the 3-spot bird (D) ends up highest.
content_en.ct_explanation: This structured way of organising data is a binary search tree: comparing the target to the current item and going left or right accordingly makes finding items efficient by repeatedly halving the search space — widely used when fast data retrieval is needed.

content_zh.prompt: 斑點布穀鳥不築巢，而是搬進空巢裡：從樹底部開始往上飛，遇到鳥巢就檢查；如果是空的就搬進去；如果已經有鳥住了，就比較身上的斑點數——如果對方斑點比較多，就繼續往左；如果對方斑點一樣多或更少，就繼續往右。樹上有5個空巢。下方共有5隻鳥，會依照圖中由左至右的順序，一隻接著一隻從樹底開始尋找空巢；第一隻進場的是有4個斑點的鳥。
content_zh.question: 哪隻鳥會搬進最高的那個巢？
content_zh.explanation: 4斑點的鳥搬進最低的巢。2斑點的鳥（比4少）往左飛到下一個空巢。3斑點的鳥因為4>3所以往左飛，遇到2斑點鳥的巢，因為2<3所以繼續往右飛，進入下一個空巢——也就是最高的那個。所以3斑點的鳥(D)最後住進最高的巢。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這種有結構的資料組織方式，就是「二元搜尋樹」：把目標跟目前的項目比較、決定往左或往右，能透過不斷把搜尋範圍減半，讓尋找變得非常有效率——這在需要快速取得資料的場合被廣泛使用。
